name: Peacock

fastest.text: Sign in at peacocktv.com in a browser, open Account → Plans & Payment and select Cancel Plan.

steps: Sign in at peacocktv.com in a web browser (the mobile app can't cancel).
Select Account in the top-right corner.
On the Plans & Payment tab, select Cancel Plan.
Confirm with Yes, Cancel. The confirmation email can take a few hours.
note: Subscribed through Google, Roku, Amazon or a provider such as Spectrum? Cancel with them; Peacock can't cancel those plans.

faq.a: No. Peacock doesn't refund or credit earlier payments when you cancel or downgrade, unless the law requires it.
It won't renew at the end of the current billing cycle. After that you can still watch a limited amount of Peacock for free.

faq.q: How do I know who bills me?
faq.a: Sign in and look under Plans & Payment, then Your Plan; your payment method is listed there.
Peacock Premium is {monthly:Premium} in the US, or {yearly:Premium} if you pay yearly.
